target_customer: Individuals and enterprises that want client-side encrypted file storage and mobile file sharing
problem: Files stored on devices and in cloud services were readable by providers, so users and companies wanted encryption that stays on the client.
business_model: Not established in sources found; described as encryption and file sharing for enterprises
product_category: Client-side encryption and secure file sharing

founders.name: Sai Thumuluru
founders.background_notes: YC page lists as Founder/CEO with no bio.

founders.name: Anirudh Ramachandran
founders.background_notes: YC page lists as Founder/CTO with no bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Client-side encryption across devices and cloud services requires careful key management and cross platform clients.

defensibility.rationale: Encryption add-ons for Dropbox and Box were being built by several startups in 2012, and cloud providers could add their own.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent action; Box already encrypted files at rest and in transit per a CSO Online comparison.

market_need_then: Dropbox had a security incident in August 2012 and third party tools to encrypt Dropbox files, such as DataNow Vault (TechCrunch, 2012-02-22), were appearing.

branding.domain_note: Used the documents.me domain; documents.me redirects to www.documents.me, which was not opened.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found, and the descriptive name is generic.

outcome_analysis: Documents.Me was a two founder YC Winter 2012 company in the Santa Clara area working on client-side encryption for devices and the cloud. No funding, traction, press or shutdown account was found, and the company is marked inactive. The cause is not public, so failure factors stay empty.
notes: The YC page text describes the company as Nouvou, offering mobile file sharing and encryption for enterprises, based in Santa Clara; this looks like a name mismatch in the directory, and no source connects Nouvou to Documents.me, so the Nouvou name is not used for facts beyond the YC page. A WebFetch of documents.me hit a redirect to www.documents.me that I did not follow. No dated competitor named Documents.me was found, so the list is empty; DataNow Vault (2012-02) is a similar tool but I could not tie it to this company's positioning. Founder education and employers are not on the YC page.
